title: Normalized ordinary tensor transport on the native etale presentation
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ any commutative ring, with lifted small etale site $J_T$ and the specified canonical equivalence to its native small etale presentation, as in [def-pur-etale-ringed-projection-presentation]. Let $C_T$ be literal restriction of the action of the sheafified constant ring to constant scalar sections, followed by inverse transport along that site equivalence. Equip both categories with their published sheafified ordinary module tensor products [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor, lem-sfb-constant-scalar-restriction-tensor]. Then $C_T$ has a braided strong monoidal structure whose comultiplication sends the ringed local pure tensor of sections $x,y$ at the transported site object to the native local pure tensor of the same sections, and whose unit comparison sends every sheafification image of a constant scalar $b\in\Lambda$ to the native unit scalar $b$. These assertions are the pure and unit fields of NativeOrdinaryTensorData in [def-pur-etale-ringed-projection-presentation]. They apply to every module sheaf and every site object. No derived comparison is asserted.

proof.text: Transport the sheafified pointwise tensor through the canonical equivalence of site presentations. Precomposition is an equivalence of presheaf categories and identifies the two sheaf subcategories. Thus sheafification and tensor commute with it. Define the comparison using these universal sheafification maps, not an arbitrary monoidal equivalence. Associativity, symmetry and unit identities reduce by the sheafification universal property to the pointwise module identities.

proof.text: Compose with scalar restriction. On a local pure tensor the two constituent comparisons are identity on the underlying tensor, and on a constant scalar in the unit they are identity. This proves both required normalizations, including the zero ring and empty-site cases.
